main_idea: On-policy distillation improves GDPval performance across Nemotron and Qwen students.
ideas: Nemotron gains +20.9% net win-loss margin and 5.1 rubric points.
Qwen reproduces the gain with +21.4% margin and 7.9 rubric points.
summary: The long headline, explanatory subtitle, and footnotes compete with two sets of model metrics and a separate task-comparison chart; the graphic is complete.
